frontMatter.introduction:
Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of advanced composite solutions, specializing in the design, engineering, and production of high-performance composite structures for diverse applications. With operations spread across multiple facilities in India, Indutch is committed to innovation, sustainability, and operational excellence.

The company integrates cutting-edge technologies with a strong focus on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) practices, ensuring that every process aligns with global sustainability standards while delivering superior value to customers.
frontMatter.objective:
The purpose of this SOP Manual is to:
Establish standardized procedures to ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry best practices.
Promote sustainable and efficient operations across all business units.
Strengthen employee awareness, training, and accountability in operational excellence.
Provide a centralized reference document for consistent implementation, monitoring, and review of Indutch's operational practices.
frontMatter.scope:
This SOP Manual applies to all Indutch facilities, employees, contractors, and stakeholders engaged in company operations, production, maintenance, quality assurance, and supply chain activities.

It serves as a unified framework for:
Environmental management and resource optimization
Health, safety, and working condition improvements
ESG compliance, supplier engagement, and ethical governance
Continuous improvement in operational efficiency across all sites
frontMatter.reviewMechanism:
The SOP Manual is formally reviewed once every year by the Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Committee in collaboration with the Quality and Compliance team.
Reviews ensure the manual remains aligned with legal requirements, ESG standards, and industry best practices.
Any emerging risks, new regulations, or technological advancements are incorporated during revisions.
Feedback from employees, auditors, and stakeholders is taken into account to strengthen procedures.
Updated versions of the SOP Manual are circulated to all concerned departments, and obsolete versions are withdrawn to prevent misuse.

blocks.text: This SOP establishes a framework for the ongoing two-way interactive communication sessions at Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd. These sessions facilitate direct communication between employees and management regarding working conditions and benefits.

This SOP applies to all employees and management personnel of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities. It specifically covers the Human Resources Department, which coordinates the sessions, and all employees who participate in the two-way interactive communication process.

responsibilities: Coordinating and facilitating the two-way interactive communication sessions.

body.text:
The HR Department schedules two-way interactive communication sessions on a monthly basis.
These sessions are set for the first Friday of each month from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM.
The venue for these sessions is communicated through email and notice boards at least one week prior to the scheduled date.

In addition to the in-person sessions, we offer a virtual option for employees to participate remotely.
This can be achieved through video conferencing platforms like Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams.
Employees interested in attending virtually can register beforehand through the company intranet or by submitting an email request to the HR Department.
Login details and instructions for accessing the virtual session are provided to registered participants prior to the session.
During the virtual session, remote participants can submit questions and comments through the platform's chat functionality or by unmute themselves to speak directly.

The HR Department moderates the sessions to ensure a structured and respectful exchange of feedback.
Employees are encouraged to provide input and feedback on working conditions and benefits directly to the management.
Management personnel are present to listen to the feedback and respond accordingly.
Each session is divided into specific topics related to working conditions and benefits for focused discussion.

Employees can submit their feedback and suggestions anonymously through suggestion boxes placed at strategic locations within the workplace.
Feedback forms are made available during the interactive sessions for employees who prefer to provide feedback in writing.
The HR Department compiles all feedback received and present it to the management for review and action.

Management develops an action plan based on the feedback received during the interactive sessions within 10 days of each session.
The action plan includes timelines and responsible parties for implementing necessary changes or improvements within 15 days of its development.
Progress on the action plan is communicated to employees through follow-up sessions and internal communications channels every 30 days until completion.

Follow-up sessions are scheduled annually to review the progress on the action plan and gather further feedback.
These sessions follow the same scheduling and conducting procedures as outlined above.

blocks.text:
It is imperative that all employees and management personnel actively participate in the two-way interactive communication sessions as outlined in this SOP.
Failure to engage in these sessions may result in missed opportunities for constructive dialogue and improvement.
Adherence to this procedure demonstrates a commitment to fostering a transparent and collaborative work environment, where feedback is valued and acted upon to enhance working conditions and benefits for all employees.
This SOP is reviewed annually by the respective personnel or department to ensure its effectiveness and relevance to the organization's needs.

sops.title: Reporting Procedure for Occupational Health and Safety (OH&S) Incidents, Risks, and Concerns

blocks.text: The purpose of this SOP is to outline the established procedure for all employees of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd to report occupational health and safety incidents, risks, and concerns. This SOP aims to ensure a safe working environment by facilitating the timely identification, documentation, investigation, and resolution of occupational health and safety issues.

This SOP applies to all employees, contractors, visitors, and management personnel of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities. It specifically covers the Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Department, which coordinates and monitors the reporting process, along with Production, Maintenance, Quality, Human Resources, Administration, and all other departments responsible for ensuring a safe workplace.

narrative.text:
All employees are encouraged to report any occupational health and safety incidents, risks, or concerns they encounter through established reporting channels.
Reporting channels include direct communication with supervisors, designated safety officers, or utilizing the company's reporting system.
Contact Person: Eknath Mangutkar
Designation: Safety Officer
Email: safety.brd@indutch.in

blocks.text:
A comprehensive record system is in place to document all complaints filed regarding occupational health and safety incidents, risks, and concerns.
Each complaint is assigned a unique identification number for tracking purposes.

body.text:
Employees are required to report any occupational health and safety incidents, risks, or concerns immediately upon discovery.
Immediate reporting ensures prompt attention and mitigation of potential hazards.
We have multiple ways for you to report occupational health and safety concerns:

Supervisor: Your supervisor is your first point of contact for reporting any immediate hazards or safety concerns. They are familiar with your work area and can take swift action to address the issue.
Safety Officer: We have a dedicated safety officer, Eknath Mangutkar who can be reached directly at safety.brd@indutch.in. They are trained to investigate safety concerns and implement appropriate solutions.
Anonymous Reporting System: If you prefer to submit a report anonymously, you can use our online safety reporting system accessible on the company intranet at https://indutch.in/contact-us/
Completed reporting forms are submitted to the designated safety officer or supervisor within 24 hours of the incident, risk, or concern occurrence.
Upon receiving a report, the designated safety officer conducts an initial assessment to determine the severity and urgency of the reported incident, risk, or concern.

A thorough investigation is conducted, which may involve gathering additional information, interviewing witnesses, and conducting site inspections.
Investigations are initiated promptly to identify root causes and prevent recurrence. Typically, investigations are completed within 7 days.

Based on investigation findings, appropriate remedial actions are implemented to address identified issues.
Remediation measures may include corrective actions, process improvements, additional training, or equipment modifications. Implementation of remediation measures is typically completed within 30 days.

blocks.text:
All reported incidents, risks, and concerns, along with investigation findings and remediation actions, are documented in the company's record system.
Documentation includes the date and time of the report, actions taken, and resolution status.
Confidentiality of reported information is maintained throughout the investigation and remediation process to protect employee privacy and prevent retaliation.

Regular training sessions are conducted to educate employees on the importance of reporting occupational health and safety incidents, risks, and concerns.
Training emphasizes the reporting process, confidentiality, and the company's commitment to maintaining a safe work environment.

It is imperative that all employees and contractors adhere strictly to the procedures outlined in this SOP for reporting occupational health and safety incidents, risks, and concerns. Timely reporting is crucial for the prompt identification and mitigation of hazards, ensuring the safety and well-being of all individuals within the premises.

Supervisors and designated safety officers are responsible for ensuring that all reported incidents, risks, and concerns are promptly addressed and investigated in accordance with established protocols. Failure to adhere to these procedures may result in compromised safety standards and potential harm to personnel and property.

This SOP is Annually reviewed and updated to ensure its effectiveness and relevance.
Feedback from employees is solicited to identify areas for improvement in the reporting process.

To outline the procedures for employees to report on flexible working arrangements implemented at Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd., in accordance with the company's commitment to supporting employees in achieving work-life balance.

This SOP applies to all employees and management personnel of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities. It specifically covers the Human Resources Department, which oversees the implementation and monitoring of flexible work arrangements, and all employees who are eligible and approved to participate in such arrangements.

body.text: Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd. recognizes the importance of providing flexible working arrangements to support the diverse needs of its employees. The following flexible working arrangements are available:

Part-time work: Employees may work fewer hours than the standard full-time work schedule, as agreed upon by the employee and their supervisor. Part-time schedules specify the number of hours to be worked per day and per week.
Telecommuting: Employees may work remotely from a location other than the company's premises for a portion of their workweek. Telecommuting arrangements specify the number of telecommuting days per week and the expectations for remote work productivity.
Job-shares: Employees may share a single full-time position with another employee, with each employee working a portion of the workweek. Job-share arrangements specify the days and hours worked by each employee.
Variable work schedules: Employees may have flexibility in their daily start and end times, within the parameters set by their department and supervisor. Variable work schedules specify the core hours during which employees must be present at the workplace.

sections.title: Procedure for Reporting Flexible Working Arrangements

body.text: Employees who wish to request a flexible working arrangement must submit a formal request to their supervisor. The request should include the desired arrangement (part-time, telecommuting, job-share, or variable work schedule) and the proposed schedule, including specific days and hours.

Upon receiving a request for a flexible working arrangement, the supervisor reviews the request in accordance with company policies and operational requirements. The supervisor considers factors such as business needs, team collaboration, and individual performance when evaluating the request.

Supervisors notify employees of the approval or denial of their request for a flexible working arrangement within [insert timeframe, e.g., five business days]. If the request is approved, the supervisor provides the employee with details of the approved arrangement, including any conditions or expectations.

Once a flexible working arrangement is approved, employees are responsible for adhering to the agreed-upon schedule and fulfilling their job responsibilities effectively. Any changes to the approved arrangement must be communicated to and approved by the supervisor in advance.

Employees with approved flexible working arrangements are required to report their hours worked and any deviations from the agreed-upon schedule accurately. Timekeeping systems are used to record hours worked, including telecommuting hours, if applicable.

narrative.text: Managers and supervisors are responsible for ensuring compliance with this SOP and monitoring the effectiveness of flexible working arrangements within their respective teams. Any issues or concerns regarding the implementation of flexible working arrangements should be addressed promptly through established channels of communication.

blocks.text: This SOP is reviewed annually to ensure alignment with company policies and best practices in flexible working arrangements. Any revisions to the SOP are communicated to all employees in a timely manner.

sops.title: Procedure for Reporting Corruption, Bribery & Information Security

blocks.text: To establish a robust reporting mechanism for employees and stakeholders to report incidents of corruption, bribery and information regarding work at Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd. This SOP ensures confidentiality, non-retaliation, and provides dedicated reporting channels for effective resolution of such issues.

This SOP applies to all employees, contractors, suppliers, customers, and other stakeholders associated with Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities. It specifically covers the Compliance and Human Resources Departments, which oversee the reporting, investigation, and resolution process, and all individuals who are obligated to adhere to the company’s standards of integrity and information security.

narrative.text:
Confidentiality Guarantee:
Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd. guarantees the confidentiality of individuals reporting incidents of corruption, bribery and information regarding work. All reports are handled discreetly, and the identities of whistleblowers are protected to the fullest extent permitted by law.
Non-Retaliation Guarantee:
Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd. prohibits retaliation against whistleblowers who report incidents of corruption, bribery and information regarding work in good faith. Any form of retaliation against whistleblowers is a violation of company policy and results in disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment or contract.
Immediate Reporting Details:
In urgent situations requiring immediate attention, individuals are encouraged to utilize the following methods for reporting incidents of corruption, bribery, or information regarding work:
Contacting the designated Compliance Officer directly via phone at +91 94095 93478.
Sending an urgent email to compliance@indutchcomposites.in with "URGENT" in the subject line.
Dedicated Reporting Channel:
Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd. provides multiple dedicated channels for reporting incidents of corruption, bribery and information regarding work:
Internal Reporting:
Employees and stakeholders can report incidents internally through the following channels:
Email: compliance@indutchcomposites.in
Phone/Hotline: +91 94095 93478
Contact Person: We have a dedicated Compliance officer, Kintan rathod who can be reached directly at Compliance@indutchcomposites.com or by calling +91 94095 93478.

body.text:
Any individual witnessing or suspecting incidents of corruption, bribery or information regarding should promptly report the matter using one of the designated reporting channels.
Reports must include detailed information regarding the incident, including date, time, location, individuals involved, and any supporting evidence available.

Upon receiving a report, the designated Compliance Officer or reporting channel initiates an investigation following established protocols. Investigations are typically initiated within 24 hours.
The investigation is conducted impartially, and utmost confidentiality is maintained throughout the process.
Whistleblowers are kept informed of the progress and outcome of the investigation, ensuring transparency and accountability.

Upon completion of the investigation, appropriate remedial actions are taken to address confirmed incidents of corruption, bribery, or information regarding work.
Remedial measures may include disciplinary actions, legal proceedings, policy enhancements, or process improvements, depending on the severity and nature of the incident. Implementation of remedial measures typically occurs within 30 days.

blocks.text:
Managers and supervisors are responsible for ensuring compliance with this SOP and monitoring the effectiveness of the reporting mechanism within their respective areas.
Any breaches of this SOP or attempts to retaliate against whistleblowers must be reported immediately to the designated compliance officer or ethics committee.

This SOP is annually reviewed to ensure alignment with legal requirements and industry best practices in combating corruption, bribery and information regarding work.
Any updates or revisions to the SOP are communicated promptly to all employees and stakeholder.

To establish guidelines and procedures for handling sensitive transactions, including gifts, travel, entertainment, sponsorships, money and other interactions with external stakeholders, at Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd. This SOP aims to ensure transparency, integrity, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations

This SOP applies to all employees, contractors, and representatives of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities. It specifically covers the Finance, Compliance, and Human Resources Departments, which are responsible for overseeing, monitoring, and approving high-risk transactions, along with all personnel engaged in interactions with external stakeholders.

sections.title: Process for Reporting and Approval of Sensitive Transactions

body.text: Employees are responsible for identifying transactions that may be perceived or implied as favors to external stakeholders. Sensitive transactions include, but are not limited to, the acceptance of gifts, sponsored travel, and other benefits from external parties.

Employees must report all sensitive transactions to their immediate supervisor or designated approver using the company's designated reporting form.
The report should include details such as the nature of the transaction, value (if applicable), purpose, and parties involved.

Upon receiving a report of a sensitive transaction, the supervisor or designated approver review the request in accordance with established criteria.
Approval thresholds and criteria are clearly defined and communicated to employees. These may include:
Maximum value limit for gifts, travel expenses, or other benefits.
Types of items accepted or permissible.
Purpose and business justification for the transaction.
If the transaction falls within pre-approved parameters, the supervisor or designated approver may grant approval.
If the transaction exceeds pre-approved thresholds or raises concerns, it may be escalated to higher management or the compliance department for further review.

Company-branded promotional items of nominal value such as pens, calendars, or notepads.
Gifts given as tokens of appreciation for significant business relationships, within predetermined value limits.
Gifts exchanged during customary celebrations, such as holidays or festivals, with modest value and cultural sensitivity.
Gifts received or given in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, with proper documentation and business justification.

Cash or cash equivalents, including gift cards, vouchers, or certificates: Any amount, as cash gifts can create the appearance of undue influence or obligation.
Gifts of significant value that may create the appearance of undue influence or obligation: Typically, any gift exceeding INR 5,000 may be considered of significant value and thus not approved.
Personal items such as clothing, accessories, or electronics, regardless of value: These items are generally not approved regardless of their cost, as they may raise concerns about conflicts of interest or ethical standards.
Gifts that violate company policies, conflict with ethical standards, or are prohibited by law: Any gifts that breach company policies or legal regulations would be considered non-approved, regardless of their monetary value.

rows.record: Approved sensitive transactions, including details of the transaction, approval rationale, and any supporting documentation

narrative.text:
Managers and supervisors are responsible for ensuring compliance with this SOP and monitoring adherence to approved transaction guidelines.
Regular audits may be conducted to review sensitive transactions and ensure compliance with established procedures.

blocks.text:
Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd. provides training to employees on the company's policies and procedures regarding sensitive transactions.
Employees should be aware of their responsibilities and the potential implications of engaging in sensitive transactions.

Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd. prohibits retaliation against employees who report sensitive transactions in good faith.
All reports of sensitive transactions are treated with confidentiality, and the identity of the reporter is protected to the fullest extent permitted by law.

This SOP is reviewed annually to ensure alignment with legal requirements and industry best practices.
Any revisions to the SOP are communicated to all employees and stakeholders in a timely manner.

sops.title: Grievance Mechanism on Discrimination, Harassment, and Labor Exploitation Issues

blocks.text: The purpose of this SOP is to outline the established grievance mechanism for addressing discrimination, harassment, child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking issues at Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd. This SOP aims to provide a fair, transparent, and confidential process for reporting and resolving grievances while ensuring support and protection for all parties involved.

This SOP applies to all employees, contractors, and stakeholders of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities. It specifically covers the Human Resources and Compliance Departments, which are responsible for managing, monitoring, and resolving grievances, as well as ensuring adherence to the company's policies on discrimination, harassment, and labor rights.

substeps.text: All stakeholders, including employees, contractors, and management, are informed about the presence of the grievance mechanism and their rights to report discrimination, harassment, child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking issues.
Information about the grievance mechanism is communicated through multiple channels, including employee handbooks, training sessions, posters, and the company intranet.
Provision of support is offered to individuals facing particular barriers such as language barriers or minority status to ensure they can effectively access the grievance mechanism.
Non-retaliation is strictly enforced to protect individuals who make use of the grievance mechanism.
Employees are assured that they not face any adverse consequences for reporting discrimination, harassment, child labor, forced labor, or human trafficking issues in good faith.
Any acts of retaliation against individuals who report grievances are subject to disciplinary action.
Steps are taken to maintain the confidentiality of individuals who make use of the grievance mechanism.
Confidentiality is upheld throughout the reporting, investigation, and resolution process to protect the privacy and dignity of all parties involved.
Information related to grievances is only shared with authorized personnel directly involved in the resolution process on a need-to-know basis.

steps.heading: Mechanism for Reporting Labor Exploitation Issues

body.text: An established mechanism is in place for different parties to report child labor, forced labor, and/or human trafficking issues.

This mechanism includes:
Communication to all stakeholders about the presence of the grievance mechanism and the provision of support for those who may face particular barriers (i.e., language, minority status).
Assurance of non-retaliation to protect those who make use of the grievance mechanism.
Steps to maintain the confidentiality of those who make use of the grievance mechanism.

Multiple reporting channels are available for individuals to report discrimination and/or harassment issues, including direct communication with supervisors, HR personnel, designated grievance officers, or anonymous reporting hotlines.
Employees are encouraged to report grievances through the channel they feel most comfortable with.
Contact Person for Reporting Grievances:
Name: Kintan Rathod
Designation: Compliance Officer
Email: kintan.rathod@indutch.in

Individuals are encouraged to report discrimination, harassment, child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking issues as soon as possible after the incident occurs.
Timely reporting facilitates prompt investigation and resolution of grievances.

All reported grievances are documented in a centralized system within 48 hours, including details such as the date, time, nature of the grievance, parties involved, and any supporting evidence.
Documentation is maintained securely and confidentially to ensure accuracy and accountability.

steps.heading: Investigation

body.text:
Upon receiving a grievance report, a thorough and impartial investigation is initiated within 5 business days by designated grievance officers or an investigation team.
Investigations are conducted promptly and objectively, respecting the principles of natural justice and procedural fairness.

steps.responsible: designated grievance officers or an investigation team

body.text:
Upon completion of the investigation, appropriate remedial actions are taken to address the grievance and prevent recurrence.
Resolutions are determined and communicated to the parties involved within 15 business days after the completion of the investigation.
Resolutions may include disciplinary action, counseling, mediation, training, policy revisions, or other corrective measures as deemed necessary.

blocks.text:
Support services are offered to individuals involved in the grievance process, including counseling, legal assistance, and access to employee assistance programs.
Support is provided to both the complainant and respondent to ensure their well-being and fair treatment throughout the process.

It is imperative that all employees and stakeholders of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd strictly adhere to the procedures outlined in this SOP for reporting and addressing discrimination, harassment, child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking issues. Failure to comply with these procedures may result in disciplinary action in accordance with company policies, as ensuring a respectful and inclusive work environment is paramount to the company's values and reputation.
All individuals involved in the grievance process are expected to cooperate fully and honestly with the investigation and resolution efforts, demonstrating their commitment to upholding the company's standards of conduct and respect for diversity and inclusion.

This SOP is annually reviewed and updated to ensure its effectiveness, relevance, and alignment with legal requirements and best practices.
Feedback from stakeholders and lessons learned from grievance resolution efforts are used to improve and refine the grievance mechanism.

sops.title: Support and Remediation Process for Victims of Exploitation

blocks.text: The purpose of this SOP is to outline the established remediation procedure in place for victims of but not limited to discrimination, harassment, child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking at Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd. This SOP aims to provide immediate support and assistance to victims while ensuring transparency, accountability, and effectiveness in the remediation process.

This SOP applies to all employees, contractors, and stakeholders of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities. It specifically covers the Human Resources, Compliance, and Health & Safety Departments, which are responsible for coordinating victim support, implementing remediation measures, and ensuring accountability in addressing cases of discrimination, harassment, and labor exploitation.

body.text:
Victims of discrimination, harassment, child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking may self-report their experiences or be identified through internal monitoring mechanisms, complaints, or third-party interventions.
Upon identification, immediate action is taken to ensure the safety and well-being of the victim.

Once a victim is identified, appropriate responses are determined based on the severity and nature of the violation.
Responses may include providing emotional support, counseling, legal assistance, workplace accommodations, or other forms of support as deemed necessary.

Transparent communication is maintained throughout the remediation process with all relevant stakeholders, including the victim, HR personnel, managers, and any other parties involved.
Regular updates on the remediation efforts are provided to ensure stakeholders are informed of the progress and outcomes.

Measures are implemented to monitor the effectiveness of the remediation efforts and the well-being of the victim.
Monitoring may involve conducting follow-up meetings, surveys, or assessments to evaluate the impact of the support provided and identify any ongoing needs.

steps.heading: Evidence of Remediation Efforts/Remediation Programmed to Support Victims of Child and/or Forced Labor

body.text: The remediation process for victims of child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking includes:

Identification of appropriate responses to the violation, considering the age, vulnerability, and specific circumstances of the victims.
Transparent communication with stakeholders involved, including relevant authorities, NGOs, and community representatives.
Implementation of measures to monitor the effectiveness of the implemented remedy, ensuring that it addresses the harm caused to the victims and prevents future occurrences.
Collaboration with external organizations and service providers specializing in victim support to ensure comprehensive remediation efforts.

Upon identification of a victim, immediate assistance is provided to address any urgent needs, such as emotional support or workplace accommodation, within 72 hours.
The victim is provided with information about available support services and their rights during the remediation process.

A dedicated case manager is assigned to oversee the remediation process for each identified victim.
The case manager serves as a point of contact for the victim and coordinates with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely and appropriate support is provided.

Victims are offered a range of support services tailored to their individual needs, including counseling, legal assistance, medical care, shelter, repatriation assistance, vocational training, and rehabilitation.
Support services are provided in collaboration with reputable organizations and service providers specializing in victim support.

blocks.text:
Compliance with this SOP is mandatory for all employees, contractors, and stakeholders involved in the identification, reporting, and remediation of discrimination, harassment, child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking incidents.
All employees are required to undergo regular training on recognizing and reporting instances of discrimination, harassment, child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking, in alignment with company policies and legal obligations.
Non-compliance with this SOP may result in disciplinary action, including but not limited to warnings, suspension, termination, or legal prosecution, depending on the severity of the violation and in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.

This SOP is annually reviewed and updated to ensure its effectiveness, relevance, and alignment with legal requirements and best practices.
Feedback from stakeholders and lessons learned from remediation efforts are used to improve and refine the remediation process

sops.title: Guidelines for Managing Stakeholder Confidential Information
sops.department: Information Technology (IT), Compliance, and Human Resources Departments

blocks.text: At Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd, we recognize the importance of maintaining the confidentiality and security of sensitive information, including personal data of our stakeholders. This SOP outlines the measures implemented to gain stakeholder consent regarding the processing, sharing, retention and disposal of confidential information in accordance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

This SOP applies to all employees, contractors, suppliers, customers, and other stakeholders of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities. It specifically covers the Information Technology (IT), Compliance, and Human Resources Departments, which are responsible for ensuring the secure handling, processing, sharing, retention, and disposal of confidential stakeholder information in compliance with regulatory requirements.

sections.title: Employee / Stakeholder Instructions for Consultation and Informing Customers/Clients

body.text: Prior to collecting any personal data from customers/clients, employees must provide clear and transparent information regarding the type of data being collected, the purpose of collection, and any potential sharing with third parties. This information should be communicated verbally or through written consent forms.

Employees must inform customers/clients about any intention to share their personal data with third parties. This includes specifying the types of data shared and the purpose of sharing. Consent must be obtained before sharing any sensitive information.
Customers/clients should be informed about the storage procedures for their personal data, including the duration of retention and the security measures in place to protect their information.

Access to physical storage areas containing third-party data is restricted to authorized personnel only. These areas are secured with locks and access control systems. Employees are required to log their entry and exit times when accessing these areas.

Access to digital databases and systems containing third-party data is strictly controlled through user authentication mechanisms. Each employee is assigned a unique login ID, and access privileges are granted based on job roles and responsibilities.

substeps.text: No Relinquishment Required: Workers are never required to relinquish their personal identification documents (e.g., passports, ID cards) to the company.

Safe Storage: Provide employees with secure means to store their personal identification documents, such as individual lockers or safe deposit facilities, ensuring they retain control over their personal documents at all times.

Periodic Risk Assessments: Conducting periodic risk assessments helps identify potential vulnerabilities in the handling of stakeholder's confidential information. By proactively assessing risks, the company can implement appropriate controls and measures to mitigate these risks and enhance data security.

sections.title: Employee Instructions for Information Security Breaches

body.text:
Monitoring Systems: Utilize monitoring systems to detect unusual or unauthorized access attempts and data breaches.
Reporting: Encourage employees to report any suspicious activity or potential breaches immediately to the IT department.

Containment: Immediately isolate affected systems to prevent further damage or data loss.
Assessment: Conduct a rapid assessment to determine the scope and impact of the breach.
Notification: Notify the relevant internal stakeholders, including management and legal teams, about the breach.
Communication: Inform affected parties, including customers and clients, about the breach and the steps being taken to address it. Provide them with guidance on protective measures they can take.

Root Cause Analysis: Identify the root cause of the breach and implement measures to prevent recurrence.
Recovery: Restore affected systems and data from backups and ensure all vulnerabilities are addressed.
Review: Conduct a post-incident review to identify lessons learned and improve future breach responses.

sops.title: Incident Response Standard Operating Procedure
sops.department: IT Security, Compliance and Security Departments

blocks.text: This SOP outlines the procedures for detecting, responding to, and limiting the impact of information security breaches to prevent further damage and reassure affected parties. Our company is committed to maintaining the highest standards of data protection and information security. This document formalizes our Incident Response Procedure (IRP) to ensure a swift and effective response to security incidents.

This SOP applies to all employees, contractors, and third parties who have access to the information systems and data of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities. It specifically covers the Information Technology (IT), Compliance, and Security Departments, which are responsible for detecting, responding to, and mitigating information security incidents in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

Detect and respond to information security incidents promptly.
Limit the impact of security breaches.
Prevent further damage and reassure affected parties.
Document and learn from incidents to improve our security posture.

body.text:
All employees must be vigilant and report any suspicious activity or potential security breaches immediately (within 1 hour of discovery) to the IT Security Team.
Indicators of a breach may include unusual system behavior, unauthorized access attempts, or unexpected data anomalies.

Report the incident to the IT Security Team using the designated incident reporting following channels:
Email: it.brd@indutch.in
Contact Person: Rutvik Pandya, IT Security Manager
Provide the following information:

Time and date of the incident
Description of the incident
Systems or data affected
Initial actions taken

steps.heading: Step 2: Alert and Contain the Breach

body.text:
The IT Security Team will evaluate the report and determine if a security breach has occurred.
If confirmed, notify the Data Protection (DP) team and Indutch Directors within 2 hours of detection.

Implement immediate actions to contain the breach and prevent further damage. This may include isolating affected systems, revoking access rights, or shutting down services.
Document all containment actions taken.

steps.heading: Breach Assessment

body.text:
The DP team, in collaboration with the IT Security Team, will perform a thorough assessment of the breach Within 24 hours of containment.
Evaluate the scope, cause, and impact of the breach, collecting and documenting evidence.

steps.responsible: DP team and IT Security Team

body.text:
Assess potential harm to the company, data subjects, and partners.
Determine if the breach meets the criteria for mandatory reporting to the Commissioner under GDPR.
Seek approval from Indutch Directors for further actions.

Based on the assessment, decide if notification to authorities and/or individuals is required.
Seek approval from Indutch Directors and consult with legal advisors if necessary.

Notify affected parties, including data controllers, data subjects, and the Supervisory Authority, as required.
Provide clear and concise information about the breach, potential risks, and steps being taken to mitigate the impact.

Implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) to address the root cause of the breach and prevent recurrence.
Verify and document the implementation of CAPAs.
Maintain a detailed log of the containment and mitigation actions taken during the incident response.

Conduct a post-incident review to identify lessons learned and opportunities for improvement.
Update the IRP and related policies based on the review findings.

Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. (Indutch) is committed to providing fair and competitive compensation to all employees. This SOP outlines our practices for base salary, overtime pay, benefits, and performance-based incentives.

This SOP applies to all employees and management personnel of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities. It specifically covers the Human Resources and Finance Departments, which are responsible for administering base salaries, overtime pay, benefits, and performance-based incentives in compliance with company policies and applicable labor laws.

body.text: Indutch conducts regular salary reviews to ensure our base salaries are competitive within the composite manufacturing industry and the local job market. We utilize reputable salary surveys and industry benchmarks to guide our compensation decisions.

Once the monthly attendance and performance data is finalized (typically by the 5th of each month), the Human Resources (HR) department calculates the gross salary for each employee. This includes base salary, allowances (based on attendance records and company policy), and any applicable bonuses.
Salaries are subject to statutory deductions like Provident Fund (PF) and Employee State Insurance (ESI) as per government regulations.
The HR department prepares a payroll report for approval by the designated authority (e.g., Finance Manager) before the designated payment date.

Indutch utilizes Electronic Clearing System (ECS) for salary disbursement.
Employee bank account details are collected and verified during the onboarding process.
Salaries are typically credited to employee bank accounts within 2-3 business days after the payroll is finalized and approved. This timeframe may vary slightly depending on bank processing times.

blocks.text: Indutch complies with all applicable laws and regulations regarding overtime pay. Employees who work hours exceeding the standard workweek (48 hours per week) receive overtime pay at a rate of 1.5 times their regular hourly rate for the first eight hours and double their regular hourly rate for any hours exceeding 56 hours per week. All overtime must be pre-approved by the employee's supervisor except in emergency situations.
Indutch offers a comprehensive benefits package to all employees, including:

Health Insurance: Indutch provides group health insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents. This plan covers a wide range of medical services, including preventive care, hospitalization, and prescription drugs.
Paid Time Off (PTO): As per this SOP (details below).
Life Insurance: Indutch provides basic life insurance coverage to all employees. Optional additional coverage is available at employee expense.
Retirement Savings Plan: Indutch offers a company-sponsored retirement savings plan with employer matching contributions.
Other benefits as deemed appropriate by the company (e.g., meal coupons, wellness programs)
These are fixed monthly payments provided to employees to cover specific expenses incurred while performing their duties. Common allowances may include:

House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Conveyance Allowance (CA)
Dearness Allowance (DA) (if applicable)

Annual Performance Bonus: This type of bonus is awarded based on individual or team performance over the course of a fiscal year. The percentage can range from 5% to 20% of the employee's annual salary, depending on performance metrics and company profitability.
Profit-Sharing Bonus: Profit-sharing bonuses are tied directly to the company's profitability. Employees receive a percentage of the company's profits as a bonus. The percentage can vary widely but is commonly around 2% to 7% of the employee's annual salary.
Increment for Cost-of-Living Adjustment (COLA): COLA increments are provided to adjust salaries according to the cost of living increases in a particular region. This increment can range from 1% to 5% annually, depending on inflation rates and economic conditions.
Merit-Based Salary Increment: Merit-based increments are awarded to employees based on their individual performance, skills, and contributions to the company. The percentage can vary widely but is commonly around 3% to 10% of the employee's current salary.
Other Details: Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd.'s commitment to promoting a workplace culture that upholds principles of equality, diversity, and meritocracy in all promotion decisions. It emphasizes non-discrimination, equal access to opportunities, and merit-based criteria for advancement, fostering an inclusive environment where every employee has the chance to grow and succeed based on their skills and performance.
Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. offers a comprehensive leave policy to provide employees with time for personal needs, emergencies, and well-being.

Earned Leave (EL): All employees are entitled to Earned Leave of eighteen [18] days with full pay in a calendar year. Employees will be eligible to use EL only after getting confirmation. EL will be allotted on a pro-rata basis to bring entitlements in line with the date of joining of the employee. EL will be credited twice in every calendar year, Nine [09] EL on 1st July and nine [09] EL on 1st January of each year. EL cannot be clubbed with CL. Un-availed Earned Leave can be accumulated up to a maximum of sixty [60] days during employment. Leaves exceeding the prescribed limit will be encashed at the end of calendar year and paid along with salary of January every year. In case of separation of employee from the organization, accumulated EL will be encashed and paid along with final dues payable to employee by the company. In case of death of an employee, payment will be made to the Nominee. If there is no Nominee, the company will pay the person obtaining the letter of succession from the court.
Casual Leave (CL): All employees are entitled to Casual Leave for six [6] days in a calendar year. CL will be credited at the beginning of the calendar year and employees can avail CL on pro-rata basis. CL will automatically lapse at the end of the calendar year and will not be carried forward or en-cashed. CL cannot be used for more than 2 consecutive days at a time. CL cannot be clubbed with EL or Sick Leave.
Compensatory Leave (C-Off): Any staff member, who has worked on Paid Holiday, Week off or worked extra when shift reliever has not been available, or for business exigencies, shall be eligible to avail Compensatory Off [C-off]. However, any employee from Manager & Above cadre, or any employee who is allowed to work in flexible shift timing or who is allowed to work from home is not eligible for C-Off. C-off will be credited to employee account only if it is approved by respective Head of Department. Any unused C-off will lapse after 60 days from the date of credit. C-off is not en-cashable.
Short Leave: Short Leave is provided to employees to cater for unplanned personal work and emergencies requiring immediate attention. Short leave can be availed for a maximum duration of two [2] hours and for maximum two instances in a month and cannot be taken on the same day or carried forward or accumulated.
Special Leave: Special leave may be granted for various domestic and personal reasons. Employers may offer paid or unpaid special leave depending on the employee's circumstances. These leaves can be used only in cases where the does not have any other leave left in balance. These leaves are permissible for employees of Deputy Manager and above only. These leaves will be approved by HR only upon recommendation of section head or head of department.
Maternity Leave: Maternity leaves will be applicable to eligible employees as per The Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 and amendment therein.
Paternity Leave: The policy grants male employees, only for their 1st & 2nd child, paid leave for a period of seven [7] working days to take care of his wife and newborn child. This paid leave of seven [7] days is over and above the earned leave quota granted to employees. Paternity leave can be availed seven [7] days before or within three [3] months from the date of delivery of child. If such leave is not availed within the said period, it shall be treated as lapsed. Un-availed Paternity Leave does not get carried forward to the next year. Employees desiring to avail Paternity Leave must inform their Section Head or Head of Department of the tentative dates of the leave at least 15 days prior to the intended start day of leave. The employee must submit copy of Birth Certificate/Medical documents to support the grant of Paternity Leave.
Sabbatical: Sabbatical assistance would be granted to the employees in case of employees' own medical exigencies requiring long term requisite treatment. All employees who have completed at least two [2] years of continuous service are eligible for Sabbatical. Sabbatical shall be without pay, salary allowances and any consequential monetary or non-monetary benefits. Sabbatical will be granted maximum up-to one [1] year in the entire service tenure of the employee. Sabbatical must be for a period of at least three [3] months or above at a stretch and only once during a calendar year. During sabbatical the employee shall not take up any employment/vocation/business/ profession elsewhere. Eligible employees wanting to avail themselves of this assistance should approach their reporting head of department for approval in writing. Approval would be subject to joint discretion of the Head of the Department and Head HR.
Study Leave: To encourage the pursuit of further studies, which would be beneficial to the employee and the organization, the company provides study leave to prepare and appear in examinations. Study leave can be granted once in two [2] years and for not more than a period of three [3] weeks, of which 50 % i.e. one-and-half [1.5] weeks will be granted by the company, over and above the allotted leaves. The balance one-and-half [1.5] weeks will be adjusted against the leave balance of the employee. Approval would be subject to joint discretion of the Head of the Department and Head of HR.
Paid Holidays (PH): To provide all employees the benefits to celebrate and cherish festivals as well as national holidays, paid holidays will be declared by management. The Management will decide the list of holidays applicable for every calendar year, for each location on the beginning of calendar year. The management reserves the right to change the declared paid holidays and increase or decrease the number of paid holidays, based on the exigencies of business. Change if any, shall be communicated to the employees from time to time. A Festival or National Holiday may not be granted to an employee who cannot be relieved due to the nature of his/ her duties or due to exigencies of work in such cases, the employee shall be entitled to Compensatory Off.
Leave During Notice Period: No leave will be allowed during the notice period. Pre-approved earned leave may be cancelled at the discretion of management. If any employee is absent during the notice period, then absent days salary will be deducted from his dues even though he/she will not earn any salary for the absent days. At the sole discretion of management, the notice period will be extended suitably.

Indutch is committed to paying a living wage to all employees. We conduct a living wage analysis at least once annually using the Anker Methodology, a recognized methodology by the Sustainable Trade Initiative (IDH). This analysis compares our base salaries against the living wage benchmark for our region. Based on the results of this analysis, Indutch may take steps to close any living wage gap, such as:

Increasing base wage levels
Reviewing wage structures
Improving in-kind benefits

Indutch utilizes an open and transparent recruitment process that prohibits discrimination based on factors such as race, gender, age, religion, or disability. All job openings are posted internally and externally, and all qualified candidates are given a fair chance to compete for open positions. The selection process is based on merit and job-related criteria.

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) outlines the recruitment process followed by Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd to ensure a fair, transparent, and merit-based selection of qualified candidates. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants and adhering to all labor laws and regulations.

This SOP applies to all recruitment activities conducted by Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities. It specifically covers the Human Resources Department, which is responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process in coordination with respective department heads to ensure fair, transparent, and merit-based hiring.

body.text:
All job openings are advertised on reputable job boards and our company website at least 7 days prior to the application deadline. The advertisement clearly outlines the job description, required qualifications, and application process.
We acknowledge receipt of all applications within 2 business days.
Shortlisted candidates are contacted by phone or email within 10 business days of the application deadline to schedule an interview.
Unsuccessful candidates are notified via email within 15 business days of the interview. We provide feedback upon request, wherever possible.

blocks.text: The selection process at Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd is designed to identify the most qualified candidates in a fair, transparent, and merit-based manner. Below is a comprehensive outline of the selection process, including additional details:

body.text:
Upon the closure of the application period (minimum 7 days prior to the application deadline), the HR department conducts an initial screening of all received applications.
Applications are reviewed to ensure they meet the minimum qualifications and requirements outlined in the job advertisement.

Based on the initial screening, candidates who best match the job requirements are shortlisted for further consideration.
Shortlisted candidates are typically notified within 10 business days of the application deadline via phone or email to schedule an interview.

Interviews are conducted in at least two stages to thoroughly evaluate candidates' qualifications, skills, and fit for the role.
The first stage usually involves a panel interview consisting of the hiring manager and an HR representative.
Depending on the seniority of the position or specific requirements, additional interview stages may be incorporated, such as technical assessments or presentations.
During the interview, a pre-defined set of criteria and scoring rubric is utilized to assess candidates objectively.

After the interview stages, reference checks are conducted for the shortlisted candidates.
Prior to contacting references, written consent is obtained from the candidates to ensure compliance with privacy regulations.

steps.heading: Final Selection and Offer of Employment

body.text:
Following the completion of all interview stages and reference checks, the hiring panel evaluates each candidate's performance and suitability for the position.
A final selection decision is made based on merit, qualifications, and alignment with the company's values.
An employment offer is extended to the selected candidate, detailing the terms and conditions of employment.

Candidates who are not selected for the position are promptly notified via email within 15 business days of the interview.
Upon request, constructive feedback may be provided to unsuccessful candidates to support their professional development.

blocks.text:
We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all qualified candidates without discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
At Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd, we are committed to maintaining a balanced gender ratio across all levels of the organization. We ensure equal opportunities for both men and women in recruitment, promotion, and career development processes.
We actively promote equality by ensuring that all qualified candidates, regardless of their background, have equal access to opportunities for employment and advancement within the organization.
Inclusion is woven into the fabric of our company culture, where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives and talents to our collective success.
All interview questions are job-related and relevant to the advertised qualifications.

At Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd, we adhere to a meticulous recruitment procedure ensuring fairness, transparency, and compliance with all relevant regulations. As part of this process, age verification documents are required from candidates to validate their eligibility to work. Below is the list of documents required for age verification, along with the procedure and timeline involved:
Documents Required for Age Verification

Aadhaar Card
PAN Card
If the candidate does not have either of these documents, they are requested to provide an alternative document such as a Birth Certificate or another government-approved document that can identify age within an additional 3 business days.
Timeline for Submission

Candidates are required to submit these documents along with their application materials within the specified application period, which typically spans the duration of the job advertisement period (minimum 7 days prior to the application deadline).
Verification Process

Upon receipt of applications, our HR department promptly verifies the age verification documents submitted by the candidates.
The verification process is conducted within 2 business days of receiving the application materials.
Consequences of non-submission

In the event that a candidate fails to provide the required age verification documents within the stipulated timeline:
The candidate is notified via email within 3 business days from the application deadline regarding the missing documents.
They are given a grace period of 5 business days to submit the necessary documents.
If the documents are not provided within the grace period, the application is considered incomplete, and the candidate is disqualified from further consideration for the position.
Confidentiality and Security Measures

We ensure the confidentiality and security of candidates' personal identification documents:
Only photocopies of the original documents are retained for verification purposes.
Photocopied documents are securely stored in our HR department's confidential filing system.
After a period of one year, photocopies are shredded to maintain confidentiality.

We never require candidates to relinquish their original personal identification documents.
If required for verification purposes, only photocopies of these documents are retained.
Photocopied documents are securely stored in the HR department's confidential filing system and shredded after a period of one year.
Candidates are provided with a secure locker to store their belongings during the interview process, if necessary.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for career growth and adhering to all labor laws and regulations.

This SOP applies to all employees of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities. It specifically covers the Human Resources Department, which is responsible for coordinating and overseeing the promotion process, in collaboration with department heads and management personnel to ensure fair, transparent, and merit-based career advancement.

body.text:
Promotion opportunities are communicated to all eligible employees through internal notices, emails, and the company intranet.
The communication includes the criteria for promotion, the application process, and the deadline for applications or nominations.
Employees are encouraged to apply or nominate deserving colleagues within the stipulated timeframe.

Employees must meet the minimum tenure requirement of one year in their current role.
Performance reviews and evaluations over the past year must meet or exceed the required standards.
Additional qualifications, skills, or certifications relevant to the new role may be considered.
Employees on probation or under disciplinary action are not eligible for promotion.

Eligible employees can apply for promotion by submitting a formal application along with their updated resume and a cover letter detailing their suitability for the role.
Applications must be submitted within the specified application period, typically 15 days from the announcement.

Managers can nominate deserving employees for promotion based on their performance, skills, and potential.
Nominations must be accompanied by a justification statement and supporting documents.

blocks.text: The evaluation process at Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd is designed to identify the most qualified candidates for promotion in a fair, transparent, and merit-based manner. Below is a comprehensive outline of the evaluation process, including additional details:

Based on the initial screening, a shortlist of candidates is created for further evaluation.

Candidates are interviewed by a panel consisting of the hiring manager, an HR representative, and a senior executive.
The interview assesses the candidates' qualifications, skills, and fit for the new role using a pre-defined set of criteria and scoring rubric.

Reference checks are conducted for the shortlisted candidates after the interview.
Written consent is obtained from the candidates before contacting references to ensure compliance with privacy regulations.

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) outlines the guidelines for competitor interactions followed by Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd to ensure compliance with legal requirements and maintain ethical business practices. These guidelines are essential to prevent any perceived collusion or anti-competitive behavior and to uphold the integrity of our operations.

This SOP applies to all employees of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt. Ltd. across all departments and facilities, with particular emphasis on employees in Sales, Marketing, and Business Development roles who are more likely to interact with competitors. It specifically covers the Compliance and Legal Departments, which are responsible for monitoring adherence to competition laws and ensuring ethical practices in competitor interactions.

Internal Training: All relevant employees receive training on these guidelines as part of their onboarding process and through regular refresher sessions every year.
Employee Handbook: Guidelines are included in the employee handbook and are accessible on the company intranet.
Updates: Any updates to these guidelines are communicated to all relevant employees within 5 business days via email and updated on the company intranet.

body.text:
Avoid Discussions on Sensitive Topics: Employees should avoid discussing prices, pricing policies, costs, marketing strategies, terms of sale, or any other competitively sensitive information with competitors.
Document Interactions: All interactions with competitors should be documented, including the date, participants, and topics discussed, within 24 hours of the interaction.
Be Aware of Antitrust Laws: Employees should have a basic understanding of antitrust laws and how they apply to their roles to prevent any unintentional violations.
Sales representatives are often in situations where interactions with competitors are more likely. To ensure appropriate conduct, the following procedures should be adhered to:

substeps.text: Meetings and Conferences: Attendance Approval: Obtain prior approval from a supervisor or the legal department at least 5 business days before attending any industry meetings, conferences, or events where competitors will be present.

Meetings and Conferences: Agenda Review: Review the agenda at least 3 business days in advance to ensure no competitively sensitive topics will be discussed. If such topics arise unexpectedly, excuse yourself from the discussion immediately and report the incident to your supervisor within 24 hours.
Meetings and Conferences: No Private Meetings: Avoid private meetings with competitors. Any interaction should be in a public or professional setting with other industry participants present.

Trade Shows and Exhibitions: Booth Conduct: Interactions at trade shows should remain professional and focus on demonstrating products and services. Avoid discussions about company-specific strategic information.
Trade Shows and Exhibitions: Information Sharing: Only share publicly available information and avoid any exchange of confidential or proprietary information.
Customer Interactions: Customer Discussions: Do not discuss competitors' pricing, terms of sale, or strategies with customers. Focus discussions on our products and services and their benefits.

Customer Interactions: Reporting Competitive Information: If customers provide information about competitors, document the details and report it to your supervisor within 24 hours without engaging in a reciprocal exchange of information.

Industry Forums and Associations: Participation Approval: Obtain prior approval from a supervisor or the legal department at least 5 business days before participating in any industry forums or associations.

Industry Forums and Associations: Active Monitoring: Continuously monitor discussions to ensure compliance with these guidelines and excuse yourself from any inappropriate discussions immediately, reporting the incident within 24 hours.

body.text:
Incident Reporting: Any suspicious or inappropriate interaction with competitors should be reported immediately to a supervisor or the legal department within 24 hours.
Non-Retaliation Policy: Employees reporting such incidents in good faith are protected under our non-retaliation policy.

blocks.text:
Documentation: Maintain records of all competitor interactions, including the context and content of discussions. These records should be stored securely and accessible for review if needed.
Review Period: All records are reviewed annually by the compliance department to ensure adherence to these guidelines.

Annual Review: This SOP is reviewed and updated annually to ensure compliance with legal requirements and best practices in competitor interaction.
Compliance Audits: Periodic audits are conducted annually to ensure adherence to these guidelines, and any deviations are addressed promptly.

sections.title: Employee Instructions and Procedures to Avoid Perceived Collusion

steps.heading: Employee Instructions and Procedures to Avoid Perceived Collusion

body.text:
Avoid Price Discussions: Under no circumstances should employees discuss pricing, pricing policies, discounts, or any related topics with competitors.
No Market Allocation: Do not agree with competitors to divide markets, customers, or territories.
Independent Decision-Making: All business decisions, including pricing and market strategies, must be made independently and not influenced by competitors' actions.
